issues.element: Disabled 'Clear filters' (no filters set) and disabled 'Previous' on Requests page 1 still sit on a filled lifted-grey surface, the same surface that marks the selected tab/pill; only the dimmer text separates them from enabled buttons. On Requests the disabled Previous has more visual weight than the enabled Next.
issues.fix: Disabled buttons: no fill, transparent or very faint border, ~40% text. Reserve the lifted grey surface for selected/pressed state. Give enabled secondary buttons (Refresh, Next, Details) a 1px border on the base surface. The new Apply treatment is the right model; apply it to these two buttons.

issues.screen: overview, tokens (all tabs share the toolbar)
issues.element: Clear filters and Refresh collapse to unlabelled 32px icon squares at the right of the time-range row. A bare x in a box reads as close/dismiss. The toolbar refresh icon also duplicates the app-header refresh icon about 100px above it, with no hint how the two differ.
issues.fix: Keep the 'Clear filters' and 'Refresh' labels down to 1024 by moving the action pair onto the search row, or use a filter-off icon with a visible tooltip. Use a distinct label such as 'Refresh data' so the toolbar Refresh is not mistaken for the header refresh.

issues.element: Toolbar row 2: Clear filters/Refresh are pinned to the far right, about 2,000px from the Daily pill group, with only the 11px 'Current bucket: hour' readout next to them. The eye has to cross the whole screen between choosing a range and refreshing it.
issues.fix: Cap the toolbar's content width (e.g. 1600–1800px) or keep the action pair right after the bucket group with a fixed gap, as the reference does with 'Clear all' after its controls.

issues.element: Flat-series KPI sparklines (Failed events, Cache-write tokens, Reported reasoning tokens, Priced/Unpriced events) draw a full-width hairline. At 390 it reads as a divider or an input underline, not a chart.
issues.fix: Give flat series the same box height as other sparklines, centred, with endpoint dots, or replace the line with a grey 'No change' label.

issues.element: Mobile view tabs are a 3x2 grid in which only the selected tab has a surface; unselected tabs are bare text with no track, so the grid reads as labels, not a segmented control. At 320 'Tokens & Cache' wraps to two lines and KPI labels such as 'p95 execution duration · ms' wrap to three.
issues.fix: At <600 use one horizontally scrollable segmented row inside a bordered track (44px tall, 13px labels) or a select. Shorten KPI labels at <400 (e.g. 'p95 duration · ms').

issues.element: On phones the first screen holds the header, tabs, filters and four rows of KPI tiles; the Usage/Token trend chart starts about 1.5 screens down.
issues.fix: At <600 render the KPIs as a compact 2-column number list without sparklines (or a horizontal scroll strip) so the primary chart starts within the first screen.

issues.element: KPI tile labels wrap unevenly ('p95 execution duration · ms', 'Reported output tokens' take two lines while siblings take one), so icon and label baselines differ across one row.
issues.fix: Set a two-line minimum height for the label block so every tile in a row shares the same label box, or use shorter labels at these widths.

issues.element: View tabs are 30px tall at 13px and the range/bucket pills are 32px at 12px, so the two segmented groups stacked in the same toolbar have different heights and type sizes.
issues.fix: Use one segmented-control spec (32px, 12–13px, same radius and padding) for tabs, range and bucket groups.

issues.element: Every chart repeats two lines of instructions ('Lines use separate scales…', 'Hover or focus a time…'). KPIs show 'Partial' and 'No range total' with no explanation of what is partial or missing.
issues.fix: Show the hover hint once per page (or as a tooltip on the chart title). Make 'Partial' a link or tooltip that names the unmeasured hours, and replace 'No range total' with 'Not measured for this range'.

issues.element: The three-up KPI row stretches each tile to ~560px (2293) or ~1,100px (3440) while the value stays left and the sparkline is pushed to the far right, leaving a dead band in the middle of every tile.
issues.fix: Cap KPI tile width (e.g. 420px) and left-align the group, or place the sparkline directly after the value with a max width.

issues.element: The note 'Legacy cache-write lifetime unavailable' gives neither a reason nor its effect on the estimate.
issues.fix: Say what it means, e.g. 'Cache writes from before <date> have no lifetime, so they are priced at the 5-minute rate' or 'excluded from the estimate'.

issues.element: The p95 reported TTFT KPI reads 'Unavailable' even though the chart below has hourly values. 'No range total; hourly values below' is accurate but makes users scroll to find out why.
issues.fix: Show the latest hourly value or the hourly range (e.g. '210–320 ms hourly') in the tile, with 'no single range total: mixed methods' as the caption.

issues.element: The Duration trend line has lost its area fill (r14 had one), while Usage trend, Token trend and Cost trend keep theirs, so the same chart component now looks two ways.
issues.fix: Pick one rule (fill the primary series in every trend chart, or in none) and apply it everywhere.

issues.element: The header says '128 retained events'; the footer shows only 'Page 1' with Previous/Next and no total or row range.
issues.fix: Show 'Rows 1–3 of 128' or 'Page 1 of 43' beside the pager.

issues.element: Row detail opens through a bordered 'Details' button on Requests but through a bare disclosure triangle labelled 'Rate details' on Model Rates.
issues.fix: Use one row-detail affordance: either both bordered buttons or both disclosure buttons with the same border, height and icon.

issues.element: Time-range pills, bucket pills, outcome select and search stay fully enabled on Model Rates, although the page states that these are current configured rates, not historical ones. Clicking them looks like it should change the table but does nothing.
issues.fix: Disable the range, bucket and outcome controls on this tab and add a tooltip ('Rates are not time-based'), or hide them; keep the provider and model filters.

issues.element: Two framing blocks (the grey 'Reference:' note and the amber catalog warning) sit above the table, and the active time toolbar competes with them, so the table itself is the fourth thing you read.
issues.fix: Merge the 'Reference' note into the table subtitle line and leave only the amber warning above the table.

issues.element: 'current configured rates' appears twice: in the Reference note and again in the 'USD per million tokens · current configured rates' subtitle.
issues.fix: Keep it once, in the subtitle.

issues.element: The numeric columns are spread across ~900px of slack after Billing model, so Input/Output/Cache values sit far from the model name they belong to.
issues.fix: Cap the table width or give the slack to the Model column; right-align the numeric group next to it.

issues.element: The empty-state card says 'Choose a longer range to look further back' but offers no button; the user has to find the range pills in the toolbar.
issues.fix: Add a secondary button in the card ('Show last 7 days') that selects the next longer range.

issues.element: Below the empty message, eight KPI tiles repeat '0'/'Unavailable', and below them the page is a large blank area. The zeros restate the message, and the void looks unfinished.
issues.fix: Collapse the KPIs to one muted summary row (or hide them) when nothing is retained, and centre the empty card in the chart's usual slot.

issues.element: The header still shows 'Partial coverage' and 'Coverage limitations' while the body says nothing was retained, which leaves it unclear whether the range is empty or unmeasured.
issues.fix: In the empty state, swap the coverage chip for the retention window (e.g. 'Retains 30 days') or hide it.

issues.element: The charts say only 'No measured values in this interval.' and each tile says 'Unavailable / No range total', with no reason (the source does not report durations? none recorded?) and no next step.
issues.fix: State why, e.g. 'This source does not report execution duration', and what to do, e.g. 'Choose a provider that reports timing' or a link to Measurement details.

issues.element: 'View data table' disclosures are still offered under charts that have no values, so they open an empty table.
issues.fix: Hide or disable the disclosure when the series has no measured points.

issues.element: With every value 'Unavailable', the page shows five equally weighted 'Unavailable' blocks, and no single message explains the state.
issues.fix: Lead with one state card like the empty and error screens ('Durations not measured for this range'), then show the muted placeholders.

issues.element: While analytics is unavailable, the range pills, filters, search and Apply stay enabled and the toolbar Refresh duplicates Retry.
issues.fix: Disable the data filters while errored and keep a single recovery action (Retry), or make the toolbar Refresh the same action and drop one.

issues.element: Retry is the only white-filled button in the product; Refresh, Apply and Next use the grey surface style.
issues.fix: Pick one primary button style and use it for Retry and for the enabled Apply.

issues.element: The app-header refresh icon shows a lifted surface during loading. It is unclear whether that means pressed, focused or busy, and it has no spinner.
issues.fix: Show a busy state (spinning icon with aria-busy) or no surface; do not reuse the selected surface.

issues.element: The skeleton tiles are blank boxes with no shimmer, and the only loading text is a small 'Loading analytics...' centred in the chart slot, so on a wide window the page looks broken for a moment.
issues.fix: Add a subtle shimmer or label placeholders to the skeleton tiles and put the loading message near the top (e.g. next to the Analytics title).

regressions: Selected tabs and pills dropped from weight 600 to 500 (r14 to r15). Selection is now carried only by the lifted surface and a slightly brighter label, which is subtler at 2293 and 3440 ('Last 24 hours' and 'Auto' are easy to miss). This avoids width shift, but consider adding a 1px brighter border or keeping the bold weight to restore salience.
Performance Duration trend lost its area fill, so it no longer matches the Usage, Token and Cost trend charts.

Improvements since r14 (not regressions): the disabled Apply now reads as disabled (r14 looked enabled); the search placeholder no longer clips at 768–1024; 'Current bucket: hour' now has a clear gap from the bucket group at 1440; Requests Details buttons are larger.
reference_gaps: The reference keeps 'Clear all' and 'Refresh' as labelled buttons at every desktop width; Prox collapses them to icon-only squares at 1280 and below.

The reference puts search on its own full-width row and the filter dropdowns on an equal-width row below it, with filters applied live. Prox shares one row between search, an extra Apply button and three native selects.
The reference shows refresh status next to Refresh (the '(6s)' auto-refresh chip); Prox shows 'Updated:' only in the page header, far from the Refresh control.
The reference has a 'Custom' range segment and visibly greyed disabled segments (1 Min); Prox has no custom range and no disabled-segment style, even on Model Rates where the range does not apply.
The reference keeps its segmented groups in bordered tracks at all widths; Prox's mobile tabs become an unbordered 3x2 grid.
The reference's dropdowns are styled controls with their own chevrons; Prox uses native select chevrons, which look heavier and differ by platform.
At ultra-wide sizes the reference keeps its actions grouped; Prox pins Clear filters/Refresh about 2,000px from the range controls at 3440.
